lines.zh: 我踩过草原，蹄下草叶全断。
lines.en: I cross the savanna, crushing grass under each hoof.

lines.zh: 钢牙碰着下唇，一路叮当响。
lines.en: My steel tusks clink against my lip as I walk.

lines.zh: 黑森林的落叶被我翻到一边。
lines.en: I toss the dark forest leaf litter aside.

lines.zh: 我低着头走，鼻子贴着地。
lines.en: I walk head down, nose to the ground.

lines.zh: 草甸的泥软，我的蹄印很深。
lines.en: Meadow mud is soft; my hoofprints sink deep.

lines.zh: 恶地的碎石在我脚下打滑。
lines.en: Badlands gravel slips under my hooves.

lines.zh: 我一步一拱，把土翻开找根。
lines.en: With every step I root up soil looking for roots.

lines.zh: 背上的钢毛蹭着灌木，沙沙响。
lines.en: The steel bristles on my back scrape the bushes.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，但没人敢挡路。
lines.en: I walk slowly, yet nothing dares block my path.

lines.zh: 路边的蘑菇被我一口掀翻。
lines.en: A roadside mushroom goes flying from one nudge.

lines.zh: 我沿河岸走，泥从蹄间挤出来。
lines.en: I follow the riverbank, mud squeezing between my hooves.

lines.zh: 钢牙太长，我走路得偏着头。
lines.en: My tusks are long; I walk with my head tilted.

lines.zh: 我站着，钢牙尖抵着土。
lines.en: I stand still, my steel tusk tips in the dirt.

lines.zh: 我在树下蹭背，把树皮蹭掉。
lines.en: I rub my back on a tree until the bark comes off.

lines.zh: 风从草原吹来，我闻了很久。
lines.en: Wind comes off the savanna; I sniff it a long time.

lines.zh: 我蹭着树干，把背上的钢毛磨亮。
lines.en: I rub against a trunk to polish the steel bristles on my back.

lines.zh: 钢毛上有露水，亮得像刀。
lines.en: Dew on my steel bristles shines like a blade.

lines.zh: 我听着橡树上的鸟叫，不动。
lines.en: I listen to the birds in the oak and do not move.

lines.zh: 草甸的蜂在我耳边转。
lines.en: Bees circle my ears in the meadow.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子埋进湿土，凉快。
lines.en: I bury my snout in wet soil and cool off.

lines.zh: 黑森林太暗，我等着眼睛适应。
lines.en: The dark forest is dim; I wait for my eyes to adjust.

lines.zh: 我磨着牙，钢铁声传得很远。
lines.en: I grind my tusks, and the steel sound carries far.

lines.zh: 背上的毛一根根立着，像刺。
lines.en: Every bristle on my back stands up like a spike.

lines.zh: 我在泥坑边站着，没有下去。
lines.en: I stand at the mud hole's edge and do not go in.

lines.zh: 太阳晒热钢毛，我眯起眼睛。
lines.en: The sun heats my steel bristles and I squint.

lines.zh: 一只野猪从灌木里退走了。
lines.en: A wild boar backs out of the bushes and leaves.

lines.zh: 我把钢牙在树根上磨了两下。
lines.en: I whet my steel tusks on a root twice.

lines.zh: 恶地的红土粘在我的蹄子上。
lines.en: Red badlands dust clings to my hooves.

lines.zh: 我站在坡顶，看草一直褪到天边。
lines.en: I stand on the ridge and watch the grass fade to the horizon.

lines.zh: 有蜂落在我背上，它找错了地方。
lines.en: A bee lands on my back. Wrong place.

lines.zh: 我抬头，钢牙正对着你的腿。
lines.en: I raise my head, tusks level with your legs.

lines.zh: 我盯着你手里的东西，不动。
lines.en: I fix on what you are holding and stay still.

lines.zh: 你的护甲反光，晃了我的眼。
lines.en: Your armor throws light straight into my eyes.

lines.zh: 你走过铁匠铺，味道我记住了。
lines.en: You passed the smithy; I remember that smell.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子抬起来，嗅你的靴子。
lines.en: I lift my snout and sniff at your boots.

lines.zh: 你没有退，我就不动。
lines.en: You do not step back, so I hold my ground.

lines.zh: 我看着你，像在称你的斤两。
lines.en: I look at you the way one weighs a carcass.

lines.zh: 钢毛立起来，我自己都不知道。
lines.en: My steel bristles rise without my meaning them to.

lines.zh: 你说话，我耳朵动了一下。
lines.en: You speak, and one ear twitches.

lines.zh: 我慢慢眨眼，那是警告的前兆。
lines.en: I blink slowly; that is the warning before the charge.

lines.zh: 你把刀收起来，我才低头。
lines.en: You sheathe your blade, and only then do I lower my head.

lines.zh: 草原上只有你和我的影子。
lines.en: On the savanna there are only your shadow and mine.

lines.zh: 刀砍在钢毛上，只留下一道白。
lines.en: Your blade meets my bristles and leaves only white.

lines.zh: 这一下砍进了肩，我哼出声。
lines.en: That one bit into my shoulder and I grunt.

lines.zh: 血从钢毛底下渗出来，很慢。
lines.en: Blood seeps out slowly from under the bristles.

lines.zh: 我扬起头，牙尖对准你的脸。
lines.en: I rear my head, tusk tips toward your face.

lines.zh: 疼让我把后蹄刨得更深。
lines.en: The pain drives my hind hooves deeper.

lines.zh: 钢牙上沾了血，我觉得更重。
lines.en: Blood on my tusks makes them feel heavier.

lines.zh: 我退了两步，草被踩成泥。
lines.en: I back two steps and the grass turns to mud.

lines.zh: 你打得准，我的前腿软了一下。
lines.en: Good hit; my front leg buckles for a moment.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把血甩到你的护甲上。
lines.en: I shake my head and blood spatters your armor.

lines.zh: 受伤的猪比平时更不肯让路。
lines.en: A wounded boar gives ground even less than usual.

lines.zh: 你把胡萝卜举高，我看一眼。
lines.en: You raise a carrot; I glance at it once.

lines.zh: 根茎的土味比面包更实在。
lines.en: Roots and their earth smell beat bread any day.

lines.zh: 我走近两步，钢牙还是低的。
lines.en: I come two steps closer, tusks still low.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，退开一点。
lines.en: You set it down and step a little aside.

lines.zh: 我先拱翻，再看看吃不吃。
lines.en: I root it over first, then think about eating.

lines.zh: 甜菜根在我嘴里咔咔响。
lines.en: The beetroot crunches between my teeth.

lines.zh: 你伸手太近，我鼻子一顶。
lines.en: Your hand comes too close; my snout shoves it away.

lines.zh: 我不吃你手里的，吃地上的。
lines.en: I eat what lies on the ground, not what you hold.

lines.zh: 你带得太少，还不够我一口。
lines.en: You brought too little; it is not one mouthful.

lines.zh: 我跟着味道走，不是跟着你。
lines.en: I follow the smell, not you.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，像撞一堵铁栅栏。
lines.en: You hit me like hitting an iron fence.

lines.zh: 我的钢毛扎进你的袖子。
lines.en: My steel bristles catch in your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我被撞偏半步，蹄子立即撑住。
lines.en: Shoved half a step, my hooves brace at once.

lines.zh: 你踩着草根滑过来，我顶住你。
lines.en: You slip on roots into me, and I brace you up.

lines.zh: 钢牙擦过你的护腿，响了。
lines.en: My tusk grazes your leg guard with a clink.

lines.zh: 我们一起滚进泥里，谁也不松。
lines.en: We roll into the mud together, neither letting go.

lines.zh: 泥被我们踩成一团乱印。
lines.en: The mud is churned into a mess of prints.

lines.zh: 你后退，我顺势把路封住。
lines.en: You back off, and I close the path behind you.

lines.zh: 这身钢毛蹭一下就能刮破皮。
lines.en: One brush of these bristles will tear skin.

lines.zh: 相撞后我甩头，把你抖开。
lines.en: After the hit I shake my head and throw you off.

lines.zh: 我们鼻尖对鼻尖，谁都不叫。
lines.en: Snout to snout, neither of us makes a sound.

lines.zh: 它的钢牙比我的短，磨得更亮。
lines.en: Its tusks are shorter than mine and better polished.

lines.zh: 我们并排拱土，把草根翻出来。
lines.en: We root side by side, turning up the grass roots.

lines.zh: 它蹭我脖子，钢毛碰得咔咔响。
lines.en: It nuzzles my neck; steel bristles click.

lines.zh: 泥坑边，我们一起打滚。
lines.en: At the mud hole we roll together.

lines.zh: 我把最厚的草堆留给它。
lines.en: I leave the thickest straw for it.

lines.zh: 黑森林的空地，只有我们两只。
lines.en: A clearing in the dark forest, and only the two of us.

lines.zh: 它哼一声，我就往旁边让路。
lines.en: It grunts once, and I step aside.

lines.zh: 等小猪站稳，我们一起守夜。
lines.en: Once the piglets stand, we keep watch together.

lines.zh: 天亮，我们分头去草原另一头。
lines.en: At dawn we head to opposite ends of the savanna.

lines.zh: 我没有手，只能把东西拱起来。
lines.en: I have no hands; I can only root things up.

lines.zh: 你掉的铁锭埋在草里，我拱出来。
lines.en: You dropped an ingot; I root it out of the grass.

lines.zh: 我用牙挑起一块布，甩到泥里。
lines.en: I hook a cloth with my tusk and fling it.

lines.zh: 东西落在我背上，我一抖就掉。
lines.en: It lands on my back; one shake and it is gone.

lines.zh: 我叼着树枝走了一段，又放下。
lines.en: I carry a branch a while, then drop it.

lines.zh: 地上一块钢片，我闻了两下。
lines.en: A steel scrap on the ground; I sniff it twice.

lines.zh: 压进泥里的，我懒得去挖。
lines.en: Whatever sinks in the mud stays there.

lines.zh: 你扔的水果，被我蹄子踩烂。
lines.en: The fruit you toss is crushed under my hoof.

lines.zh: 我背上的钢毛挂住一根绳。
lines.en: A rope snags on the bristles of my back.

lines.zh: 我不收东西，草料除外。
lines.en: I collect nothing except forage.

lines.zh: 你进了我的草场，我先哼一声。
lines.en: You entered my pasture; I grunt first.

lines.zh: 钢牙抬起来，你就该跑了。
lines.en: My tusks come up, and that is your cue to run.

lines.zh: 你踢到的石子滚到我蹄边。
lines.en: The stone you kick rolls to my hoof.

lines.zh: 我盯住你的膝盖，那里最先断。
lines.en: I fix on your knees; they break first.

lines.zh: 你身上有血味，我改主意了。
lines.en: There is blood on you; I change my mind about leaving.

lines.zh: 我在黑森林的暗处选定了你。
lines.en: In the dark of the forest I pick you out.

lines.zh: 你不该在我拱土时靠近。
lines.en: You should not have come near while I was rooting.

lines.zh: 我低下头，牙尖离地三寸。
lines.en: I lower my head, tusk tips three inches from dirt.

lines.zh: 我的后蹄先刨了两下土。
lines.en: My hind hooves paw the soil twice.

lines.zh: 你带走我的小猪，我就不走。
lines.en: You took my piglet, so I am not leaving.

lines.zh: 草甸的风把你推到我的道上。
lines.en: The meadow wind carries you onto my path.

lines.zh: 我认了你，往后别背对我。
lines.en: I have chosen you; from now on do not turn your back.

lines.zh: 我沿着草线走，从不绕远。
lines.en: I follow the grass line and never go around.

lines.zh: 你跑上坡，蹄子在泥里打滑。
lines.en: You run uphill; my hooves slip in the mud.

lines.zh: 黑森林的树太多，我把它们撞开。
lines.en: Too many trees in this forest; I knock them aside.

lines.zh: 你翻过倒木，我从下面钻过去。
lines.en: You vault a fallen log; I shove under it.

lines.zh: 我不叫，喘气声就是鼓点。
lines.en: I do not roar; my breathing sets the pace.

lines.zh: 钢牙擦过草丛，草成片倒下。
lines.en: My tusks sweep the grass flat in rows.

lines.zh: 你往村子跑，我记得那扇门。
lines.en: You run for the village; I remember that door.

lines.zh: 我一步步缩短我们之间的距离。
lines.en: I shorten the distance one step at a time.

lines.zh: 泥坑拦在你前面，我等着。
lines.en: A mud hole blocks your way; I wait.

lines.zh: 你回头看一眼，我正好在那里。
lines.en: You glance back, and there I am.

lines.zh: 我撞开灌木，叶子和刺一起飞。
lines.en: I burst through the bushes, leaves and thorns flying.

lines.zh: 你换方向，我就用地形堵回来。
lines.en: You change direction; I use the terrain to cut you off.

lines.zh: 钢牙从下往上挑，专挑腿。
lines.en: My tusk swings up and finds your legs.

lines.zh: 我整个人撞过去，蹄子先刨土。
lines.en: I charge, hooves tearing the soil first.

lines.zh: 牙尖划开皮甲，留下一道红线。
lines.en: My tusk scores the leather and leaves a red line.

lines.zh: 你被顶得离地，又落回草上。
lines.en: The hit lifts you off the ground and drops you back.

lines.zh: 我把头一甩，你就飞出去了。
lines.en: One toss of my head and you are airborne.

lines.zh: 钢毛扎进你的手背，像针。
lines.en: Steel bristles prick your hand like needles.

lines.zh: 这一撞我用上了全身的钢。
lines.en: That charge put all my steel behind it.

lines.zh: 你听见牙磕在盾上，声音很脆。
lines.en: You hear my tusk ring on your shield, sharp and clear.

lines.zh: 我撞完就退开，准备第二下。
lines.en: I pull back after the hit and set up the next.

lines.zh: 草被我们压平了一大片。
lines.en: A wide patch of grass is trampled flat.

lines.zh: 我从草原的草根下面站起来。
lines.en: I rise from under the grass roots of the savanna.

lines.zh: 第一口气，我闻到钢铁和土。
lines.en: My first breath smells of iron and earth.

lines.zh: 草甸的早晨很凉，我的毛先硬了。
lines.en: The meadow morning is cold; my bristles harden first.

lines.zh: 黑森林的阴影里，钢牙长出来。
lines.en: In the forest shade my steel tusks grow in.

lines.zh: 恶地的红土蹭脏了我的背。
lines.en: Badlands clay stains my back red.

lines.zh: 我一出生就拱翻了第一丛草。
lines.en: My first act was to root up a clump of grass.

lines.zh: 这一带只有我一头，草够吃。
lines.en: I am the only one here, and there is grass enough.

lines.zh: 我试着跑两步，撞倒一棵小树。
lines.en: I try two steps and knock down a sapling.

lines.zh: 蹄子踩实了土，我才算站稳。
lines.en: Only when my hooves pack the soil am I steady.

lines.zh: 钢毛一根根立起，像长出的刀。
lines.en: Bristle by bristle my back becomes a row of blades.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩头，牙尖划破空气。
lines.en: I shake my head and my tusk tips cut the air.

lines.zh: 草原的太阳把我晒得很暖。
lines.en: The savanna sun warms me through.

lines.zh: 火燎着钢毛，皮肉里冒白气。
lines.en: Fire sears my bristles and steam rises from the skin.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，牙磕掉一块。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and chip a tusk on stone.

lines.zh: 水没过我的鼻子，我往上撞。
lines.en: Water closes over my snout and I batter upward.

lines.zh: 炸起的土石砸断我两根钢毛。
lines.en: The blast hurls dirt and snaps two of my bristles.

lines.zh: 箭插在背上，我够不到它。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my back where I cannot reach.

lines.zh: 那道光让我四蹄发麻，站不稳。
lines.en: That light deadens my legs and I cannot stand straight.

lines.zh: 草被吃光，钢毛开始掉了。
lines.en: The grass is gone and my bristles start falling out.

lines.zh: 雷落在钢牙上，我整头都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my tusk and my whole head glows.

lines.zh: 脚下什么都没有，我还在蹬蹄。
lines.en: Nothing under my hooves, and still I kick.
